name: RommDeck
description: Open a game on the machine RommDeck manages: it downloads it if needed, then plays it.

settings.label: Offer RommDeck when you press Play
settings.help: Off hides the button; RomM's own Play stays as it was.

settings.label: Hand-over parameters
settings.help: Appended to the rommdeck:// URL. RommDeck reads play=1 as download it, then play it; clear this to only open the game.

settings.label: RommDeck's web address
settings.help: Used by the Settings shortcut, for when the rommdeck:// handler isn't registered.
